comments.author: AverageDrafter
comments.body:
I just release a tool that you can use!  I started using WoW Export for my prototype a few months ago and ended up making a whole WoW to Godot system called WoWShell.  Its still in development, but the general idea is that you can point Claude at it and it does a lot of the "staging" of the assets, as well as set up the installation of the assets from a users own WoW installation.

A lot people want to turn WoW in to other games, use the existing world to make their own experiences.  I do, and I wanted to make it easier for other to do too.  Download the zip and have Claude evaluate it, it was basically made for what you are doing.

\#1 benefit, you won't have to manually export the models or other assets, you have the whole CASC at your disposal.  Here is my work on "Tank-n-Spank" my single player interpretation of the Main Tank experience, adapted into a hex based real time tactical system I am developing that feel like a mix of Beat em up, Musou, and Squad based action.

The demos that I released with the WoWShell system are a reference replica of the main game (incomplete on purpose since the goal isn't to reproduce WoW but make new games), rally racing game, and a StarCraft 2 mission reproduced in a WoW like format.

Everything distributes without Blizz assets, so you can actually share it like I am.  It pulls them from the current install, just like WoWExport does.

https://preview.redd.it/lolb598vvmwh1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=e0f11906a22249532478dd8dc571595318d9ec76

[https://github.com/AverageDrafter/WoWShell/releases/latest](https://github.com/AverageDrafter/WoWShell/releases/latest)
